application_type_full: Prior Approval: Change of use - offices to dwellinghouses
description: Prior notification for the change of use of the existing premises from offices (B1 use) to provide 171 self-contained residential flats (C3 use)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Prior to occupation of any part of the development, details of cycle accommodation for a minimum 174 spaces shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before first occupation of the relevant part of the development that use those facilities and maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 2 - Before the development hereby permitted is occupied, arrangements shall be agreed in writing with the local planning authority and be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of disabled persons, no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit within any controlled parking zone which may be in force in the local area at any time.

Condition : 3 - Prior to occupation of any part of the development, a delivery and servicing plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall provide details to how deliveries and servicing will be undertaken within the site and the measures proposed to restrict loading and unloading on the public highway. All deliveries and servicing of the site shall thereafter be managed in compliance with the approved Delivery & Servicing Plan.
